candidates.title: Move sign-in after pet selection
candidates.change: Move sign-in to after pet selection so users choose their companion before creating an account.
candidates.why: Sign-in currently drops 27.1% of users early. Letting users pick their pet first builds emotional investment before account creation.

sign_in.headline: Save your pet to an account
sign_in.body: Sign in now to sync your new pet safely across all your devices.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in after pet selection is explicitly allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in has a high drop-off (27.1%), but moving account creation requires substantial flow refactoring.

candidates.title: Interactive pet preview screen
candidates.change: Insert a interactive pet preview screen right after pet selection to show how the pet looks.
candidates.why: Adoption has a 60.9% conversion rate with long mean times (1017s), and support reports custom pets looking wrong or failing.

guard.reason: _order names screens that are neither onboarding screens nor defined here: ['new_pet_preview']

candidates.title: Desktop control carousel on loading screen
candidates.change: Redesign the waiting screen into a split layout showcasing an interactive desktop controls carousel while files load.
candidates.why: Waiting step takes a median of 201s and support receives multiple complaints from users confused on how to control/hide/talk to pets.

waiting.headline: Setting up your desktop pet workspace
waiting.body: While your pet loads, check out these tips on how to interact with your pet on desktop.

guard.reason: Redesigning the waiting screen while preserving its core job is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Addresses long wait times (median 201s) and support confusion, but requires a full loading UI redesign.

candidates.title: Instant starter pet flow bypass
candidates.change: Add one-click instant starter pet choice cards on the selection screen to skip custom photo processing.
candidates.why: 3 support emails report custom pet generation errors or bad results, causing high adoption drop-off.

guard.reason: Adding instant pet choice cards on the pick_friend screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Targeting the largest step drop (39.1%) backed by support tickets reporting custom photo errors.

candidates.title: Account sync hint on sign-in screen
candidates.change: Display a hint warning returning users to use their original sign-in method to retain pets.
candidates.why: 8 support emails (the top issue) report pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Important: Sign in with the same account you used before to keep existing pets.

guard.reason: Adding an account sync hint to the sign-in screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Strongly supported by 8 support tickets (top issue) and low cost to implement as a text hint.

candidates.title: Desktop permission check during setup
candidates.change: Add a diagnostic checklist during the waiting screen to verify desktop overlay permissions.
candidates.why: 3 support emails mention the pet not appearing on desktop or the desktop overlay failing to open.

guard.reason: Adding a permission verification checklist to the waiting screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Helps fix desktop overlay permission issues noted in support, but targets a smaller step drop.

candidates.title: Clear control instructions on home intro
candidates.change: Update the welcome text with explicit copy on right-clicking the pet to bring up desktop controls.
candidates.why: Support receives multiple tickets asking how to control, hide, or talk to their pet post-onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Your pet is live on your desktop!
home_intro.body: Right-click your pet anytime to hide, summon, or talk to them.
home_intro.hint: Try right-clicking your pet on your desktop right now!

guard.reason: Updating text copy on the home intro screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Cheap copy update addressing 35.2% completion drop-off and multiple support tickets regarding controls.

candidates.title: Two-column progress view for path selection
candidates.change: Switch choose_path screen to a clear two-column layout with visual step progress counter.
candidates.why: 23.8% of users drop off at choose_path, spending a long mean time (514s) deciding.

guard.reason: Redesigning choose_path into a two-column view with progress indicators is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Addresses the high mean decision time (514s) at path selection, but requires a layout redesign.

candidates.title: Account persistence notification
candidates.change: Show a notification explaining that account creation secures their pet against accidental data loss.
candidates.why: Addressing reset anxiety and sign-in drop-off (27.1% drop rate at sign_in).

sign_in.body: We will email you a backup link so your pet remains safe across sign-ins.

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.body' asks for or mentions personal data

candidates.title: Adoption rewards incentive banner on story screen
candidates.change: Add copy and high-emphasis button detailing unlockable pet accessories upon completing onboarding.
candidates.why: Overall onboarding completion is only 17.8%; early incentives encourage users through the long setup.

story.headline: Adopt your desktop companion today
story.body: Complete setup to unlock custom accessories and desktop mini-games!

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions unlockable accessories and mini-games, violating the ban on mentioning gifts or free extras.

picked: Clear control instructions on home intro
Two-column progress view for path selection

decisions.title: Clear control instructions on home intro
Two-column progress view for path selection

lessons_next: Bypassing onboarding steps directly (new_flow) significantly improves user conversion.
Reordering friction by moving sign-in after pet selection (reorder) significantly improves conversion.
Copy improvements, permission checks during setup, and layout changes showed no clear effect.
Predictions consistently overestimated actual measured gains across all tests.
